confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not from live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant anchors are the more reliable, since Thai tourist-island restaurant pricing is fairly well known. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July rates vary with season and Koh Samui has fewer hostel dorm beds. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer price (about 2.6x and 2.4x), not from direct price observations.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Phuket and Chiang Mai as the nearest Thai tourist-price benchmarks. Koh Samui restaurants and three-star hotels are placed near Phuket levels, and budget lodging sits between Chiang Mai and Phuket. Vientiane was used only as a lower-bound sanity check. Cocktail and wine use the beer-relationship basis described above.
